scholarships.title: International Talents @unibo — Scholarships for International Students Enrolling in Second Cycle Degree Programmes
scholarships.official_source: Alma Mater Studiorum – Università di Bologna

existing.description: The University of Bologna awards 30 International Talents @unibo study grants each year to international students who matriculate for the first time in the first year of a Second Cycle (Laurea Magistrale) degree programme. Each grant is worth EUR 6,500 gross per academic year and is awarded for two academic years, and successful applicants also receive a full tuition fee waiver, paying only EUR 157.04 in regional taxes, stamp duty and insurance premium. Selection is based on GRE General Test scores, with minimum scores of 290 in the combined Verbal and Quantitative Reasoning sections and 3.0 in Analytical Writing, together with a family economic situation within an ISEE band of EUR 16,000 to EUR 35,000. Applicants must be under 30 years old at the deadline and must not already be a student of the University of Bologna.
eligibility: Holds a qualification valid for admission to the chosen Second cycle degree programme, awarded by an institution outside the Italian education system (San Marino qualifications do not qualify); citizenship is irrelevant
Is not, and has never been enrolled as, a student of a First, Single or Second cycle degree programme at the University of Bologna, including a career closed after A.Y. 2023-24
Has an ISEE (Equivalent Economic Situation Indicator) between EUR 16,000 and EUR 35,000, or an equivalent economic situation certificate
Has not previously applied for and received an Unibo Action 2 study grant
Is less than 30 years old at the application deadline
Matriculates for the first time in the first year of the degree programme; later enrolments, course changes and transfers do not count
Is not enrolling in a multiple or joint degree programme where fees are paid to a partner university other than Bologna
existing.eligibility_summary: Holds a qualification obtained outside the Italian education system that gives access to a Second Cycle degree programme at the University of Bologna; is not a current or former student of a Bologna degree programme; has an ISEE between EUR 16,000 and EUR 35,000 or equivalent economic documentation; has not held an Unibo Action 2 grant; and is under 30 years old at the deadline.
benefits: Study grant of EUR 6,500 gross per academic year, paid over two academic years
Full exemption from university tuition fees
Only EUR 157.04 payable by the holder, covering regional tax, stamp duty and insurance premium
coverage: Study grant of EUR 6,500 gross per academic year, paid over two academic years
Full exemption from university tuition fees
Only EUR 157.04 payable by the holder, covering regional tax, stamp duty and insurance premium
requirements: Applications are submitted exclusively through Studenti Online (studenti.unibo.it); paper, fax and email applications are not accepted
International students without an Italian tax code must register through the 'International students registration' section of studenti.unibo.it
Personal details registered must match the passport or identity document exactly, and the PUK code must be replaced with a personal password
The official GRE score report must reach the University through ETS by the deadline; later scores are not accepted
All uploaded documents must be in PDF format
The 30 October-style application status messages displayed in the portal do not mean the application is complete or eligible
documents: Copy of a valid passport (EU citizens may attach a valid identity document)
Copy of the unofficial GRE score report
Official GRE score report sent through ETS using University of Bologna recipient code 7850
ISEE 2025 certificate for higher education subsidies, or other economic situation documentation per Art. 6
application_method: Register on studenti.unibo.it and obtain Unibo institutional credentials, SPID or CIE
Go to the 'Calls' section and select the International Talents @unibo call for the relevant academic year
Complete the online application and upload the passport and unofficial GRE score report as PDFs
Have ETS send the official GRE score report using recipient code 7850
Submit the ISEE or equivalent economic situation documentation
existing.selection_notes: Grants are ranked on the summed GRE General Test score, with equal weight to each section; applicants below the minimum scores are excluded. Ties are resolved in favour of the younger candidate. Results are published by a managerial decree on studenti.unibo.it. Winners must send an unconditional acceptance declaration to internationaldesk@unibo.it within 10 days of the award notification.
existing.duration: Two academic years (a standard Second Cycle degree programme)
existing.application_period: Annual call, opening in mid-January and closing at 12:00 CEST in late May (17 January 2025 12:00 CET to 30 May 2025 12:00 CEST for the 2025/26 edition); results published in July
existing.deadline_display: Applications for the 2025/26 edition closed at 12:00 CEST on 30 May 2025 ("scadenza: 30 maggio 2025, 12:00"); the call is published annually and no open window was visible on bandi.unibo.it on 4 October 2026.
existing.program_type: University merit and needs-based study grant for international students matriculating in a Second Cycle (Master's) degree programme

scholarships.title: Merit-Based International Scholarships — Politecnico di Milano (Academic Year 2027/2028)

existing.description: Politecnico di Milano runs an annual merit-based scholarship scheme for international candidates applying to the first year of an English-taught Master of Science programme. The 2027/2028 call offers 64 awards: 10 Platinum (Milan), 18 Gold (Milan), 16 Gold Piacenza Campus, 10 Bronze Piacenza Campus and 10 Silver scholarships for the Cremona, Lecco, Mantova and Piacenza campuses. Every award includes a full tuition-fee waiver for the academic year, and the cash tiers add a gross allowance of EUR 10,000 (Platinum), EUR 8,000 (Gold), EUR 5,000 (Gold Piacenza) or EUR 2,500 (Bronze); the Silver tier is a waiver only. Recipients must pay a non-refundable administrative fee of about EUR 170 on acceptance, and the awards can be renewed for a second year on academic points.
eligibility: International student (foreign citizenship plus a qualification obtained abroad) applying to the first year of a Master of Science programme taught in English
Must have submitted the admission application and paid the application fee in the Early Bird period, between 1 October 2026 and 1 December 2026
Must be admitted to the chosen study programme and accept the positive evaluation outcome
Must submit a valid certificate of English language proficiency by 4 March 2027

Must choose a programme and campus matching the tier applied for (Milan Leonardo or Milano Bovisa for Platinum and Gold; Piacenza for Gold and Bronze Piacenza; Cremona, Lecco, Mantova or Piacenza for Silver)
existing.eligibility_summary: International students who have already submitted an admission application to the first year of an English-taught Master of Science programme at Politecnico di Milano and paid the application fee between 1 October and 1 December 2026. Applicants must be admitted to the programme and accept the positive admission outcome, and must provide a valid English language certificate by 4 March 2027.
benefits: Full tuition-fee waiver for the academic year the scholarship is assigned for
Gross cash allowance of EUR 10,000 for Platinum, EUR 8,000 for Gold, EUR 5,000 for Gold Piacenza and EUR 2,500 for Bronze Piacenza
Silver tier: tuition-fee exemption only, excluding the administrative fee and insurance
coverage: Full tuition-fee waiver for the academic year the scholarship is assigned for
Gross cash allowance of EUR 10,000 for Platinum, EUR 8,000 for Gold, EUR 5,000 for Gold Piacenza and EUR 2,500 for Bronze Piacenza
Silver tier: tuition-fee exemption only, excluding the administrative fee and insurance
requirements: The application must be submitted through Politecnico di Milano Online Services at the path Benefits and Agreements > Economic benefits > Scholarships for International Master of Science Students
Only candidates who have already applied for admission to the MSc programme may participate in the call
The admission application fee must have been paid in the Early Bird window from 1 October to 1 December 2026
The candidate must pay an administrative fee of approximately EUR 170 by the deadline in the assignation email, or the scholarship is treated as not accepted
The candidate must enrol in the academic year the scholarship was assigned for, by the deadlines set by the Student Affairs Unit

Payment requires an IBAN linked to an Italian bank account, or a prepaid card linked to an Italian or SEPA account, headed only to the student and with a credit limit at least equal to the scholarship amount
documents: Completed scholarship application form submitted through Politecnico di Milano Online Services
IBAN code linked to an Italian bank account in the scholarship recipient's name, uploaded if not already on file
Valid English language proficiency certificate, submitted by 4 March 2027
Proof of admission to the Master of Science programme applied for
existing.english_requirement: The candidate must be applying to a Master of Science programme taught in English and must submit a valid certificate of English language proficiency to the University by 4 March 2027, otherwise the scholarship cannot be awarded. The call states the certificate will be conveniently confirmed by Polimi.
application_method: Apply for admission to an eligible English-taught Master of Science programme and pay the application fee in the Early Bird period (1 October to 1 December 2026)
Log in to Politecnico di Milano Online Services and open Benefits and Agreements > Economic benefits > Scholarships for International Master of Science Students
Complete and submit the scholarship application form by 12:00 noon Italian time on 15 December 2026
Watch for the outcome notification, which is displayed in the application and flagged by email
Follow the Student Affairs Unit instructions, pay the approximately EUR 170 administrative fee and enrol
Upload an IBAN if not already registered, and submit the English language certificate by 4 March 2027
existing.selection_notes: Scholarships are assigned by a Commission nominated through an Executive Decree of the Head of the Campus Life Area, including the Vice Rector for International Relations and the Heads of Schools or their delegates. To be considered, students must be admitted to the programme and accept the outcome. The Commission takes into account gender equality, country of origin and age, prioritising the youngest candidates where requirements are equivalent. The published assignment criteria on the scholarships page state that selection is based on the evaluation of previous education and its match with the programme requirements, the documents provided at application and the scholarship form, with GPA and academic achievements (including the portfolio where requested) of utmost importance.
existing.duration: One academic year, renewable for a second year on academic points
existing.application_period: Applications open 1 October 2026 and close at 12:00 noon Italian time on 15 December 2026, for admission application and scholarship for academic year 2027/2028. Eligibility is restricted to candidates who paid the admission application fee during the Early Bird period from 1 October to 1 December 2026.
existing.deadline_display: The application form must be submitted from 1 October 2026 until 12:00 noon (Italian time) on 15 December 2026 through Politecnico di Milano Online Services; a valid English language proficiency certificate must be submitted by 4 March 2027 to remain eligible for the scholarship.
existing.program_type: University merit-based scholarship scheme for international Master of Science applicants, with Platinum, Gold, Bronze and Silver tiers plus partner-funded awards
